# Claude Daily Memory v0.2.0

Claude Daily Memory is one application that turns selected Claude Code outcomes into persistent NotebookLM memory and gives Claude full local MCP access to all NotebookLM notebooks and materials.

Website: https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/
Russian: https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/ru/
Source: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory
License: Apache-2.0

## Product contract

- `./install.sh` creates one application venv with Google, Gemini, and pinned `notebooklm-py[browser,mcp]==0.8.0`.
- One confirmed setup creates/reuses a Google Doc, permanent NotebookLM notebook and source; registers local stdio MCP; stores cloud secrets in the OS keyring; and enables the timer only after full success.
- The daily job writes one sanitized daily record to Google Docs and automatically refreshes the configured NotebookLM source.
- Failed NotebookLM refresh leaves the day pending for a safe idempotent retry.
- The MCP covers all account notebooks, sources, chat, notes, research, Studio artifacts, downloads, and sharing—not only the memory notebook.
- Automatic memory excludes transcripts, full prompts/responses, tool data, Gmail, arbitrary files, and NotebookLM answers.
- NotebookLM credential state stays local; remote MCP, HTTP listeners, master tokens, environment credential export, and cloud cookie transfer are unsupported.
- Internal NotebookLM web RPCs are supplied by a pinned third-party MIT dependency and can change when Google changes its web application.
